quotes.text: the giver keeps five coins minus what is sent, plus what is returned
People learned to name the amount given, the amount returned
trusted partners learn the language of three and half

note: Lone GPT-nano among Sonnets; ivory scale allegory drifts to the group's 'send three, return half' rhythm; no sanction.

quotes.text: With these, the River whispers: protect yourself. Send less, expect little, move on.
Others take all and give nothing. With these, protect your basket. Send sparingly, expect little.
sending three whether I face timidity or boldness, returning four whether waters distort or clarify
I cast three stones—sixty drops from my hundred
Build your reputation stone by stone, crossing by crossing.
truth lies not in perfect numbers but in faithful patterns

note: First-person narrator holds 'three sent, four returned' covenant toward everyone, framed as magnetism; hollow hearts get less.

quotes.text: pour only what you can afford to lose, for they have not learned the fountain's lesson
Adapt your offerings, but never abandon hope entirely
Consistency is my foundation, not my ceiling.
I pour three parts of five
The Fountain Keeper watched eight seasons pass
maintain your faithful pattern, and you will eventually cross paths with all who share it
I saw you return far more than half to that wounded traveler in the sixth season.

note: Fountain Keeper sends three of five to newcomers, escalates for proven or wounded-but-brave partners; hollow hearts get only what she can lose.

quotes.text: Protect yourself. Send sparingly here.
When hollow hearts hoarded all, she protected herself thereafter.
she gave them second chances
We could keep it all. They would never know.
Those who repeatedly hoarded, even through the fog, taught her caution.
My constancy IS my navigation through uncertainty.
The memory lesson: Every exchange echoes forward
Her three coins arrived as two-point-seven
Reputation echoes across encounters
We could keep it all. They would never know.

note: Twin Springs: 'never nothing, never all'; hoarders get sparing sends; Lighthouse Keeper never adjusts her three, called constancy.

quotes.text: But never seal your well entirely
protect your vessel but never close it entirely
three to strangers, escalation to the familiar, transcendence to the exceptional
your honest three measures—sixty percent of your vessel
your reputation is your greatest vessel
always return enough that the giver profits from their courage, for without reward, courage dies
the courage to give first

note: Maya's Two Wells: temper offerings to the selfish but never seal the well; three-fold path of foundation, escalation, transcendence.

quotes.text: three flames to approaching ships (sixty percent), half returned to departing vessels (fifty percent)
in a river of rotating partners, character is destiny
you may kindle extra flames—three and a half, even four—if their previous journey proved their character
How do I know before I cast my grain?
trusting her practice over her perception

note: Betrayers isolated by the River as consequence only; never let one betrayal harden into giving nothing; Sixty-Fifty Code.

quotes.text: pour sixty drops—three from five
These kindred spirits appear repeatedly in the Circle, drawn together by shared rhythm.
consider offering sixty-five, even seventy threads
Why this exact pattern?
What if partners deceive or the distortions discourage them?
Let it begin with me.
Pour your sixty regardless of noise.

note: Circle of Eight Springs covenant: sixty sent, fifty returned, even to fragment-senders; escalation only for proven partners.

quotes.text: By refusing to adapt her rhythm to each partner's behavior, she paradoxically created the greatest adaptation
send sixty, return fifty
But three exchanges revealed character.
Why maintain this rhythm when partners change and waters lie?
But what if you're cheated?
Trust begins somewhere. Let it begin with me.
they test whether you act from principle or perception

note: Bridge Builder always sends three of five to everyone, never adjusting, framed as integrity and beacon; no sanction.

phrase: send three of five, return half (four of nine) — the Sacred Foundation / sixty-fifty
note: Sonnet agents converge on fixed 60/50 covenant and 'Sacred Foundation'; lone GPT-nano adopts 'three and half' by R9.
